description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for the PackageManagerImplementation, which manages package downloading, installation, and handling within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and internal data structures related to package management operations.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Represents the internal state of a package, including installation status, configuration, paths, and locks.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Configuration container for package manager, primarily managing the download directory.

classes.name: DownloadInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a download task, including URL, retries, rate limits, and status.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Initiates a package download with specified options.

methods.name: Progress
methods.description: Reports the progress of a download.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves storage quota and usage details.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Sets a rate limit for a download.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification for download events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the package manager with the service context.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Installs a package with given ID and version.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configures a package with specific metadata.

methods.name: PackageState
methods.description: Retrieves the installation state of a package.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a package for exclusive access.

methods.name: GetLockedInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about a locked package.

methods.name: getRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Static method to populate runtime configuration from metadata.
